title: Stand up a blocking GitHub Actions test pipeline for onfinance-db-model-master
description: Create .github/workflows/tests.yml in onfinance-db-model-master. On pull_request to master and push to master it checks out the code, sets up the Python version declared in setup.py (python_requires, or the version the consuming services use), installs requirements-dev.txt with --require-hashes and the package, and runs `pytest --cov` so the .coveragerc fail_under from task 3 fails the job. Pin actions by full commit SHA and set `permissions: contents: read`. Then add the job as a required status check in master branch protection of OnFinance/onfinance_db_model_master. This is scheduled to meet the ledger slaDueAt of fnd_01M2GSSNXD1T94MJ6Q346HV4S6 (2026-09-28T19:35:56Z). CI only, no deployment window applies. After the merge, ask the refresh-ctx owner to update applications/db-models/repos/onfinance-db-model-master.json ciSystem from none to github-actions.
acceptanceCriteria: A pull request to master triggers the tests workflow; `gh run list -R OnFinance/onfinance_db_model_master --workflow tests.yml` shows a completed run on that PR, and a PR that drops coverage below fail_under shows the run as failure.
`gh api repos/OnFinance/onfinance_db_model_master/branches/master/protection --jq '.required_status_checks.contexts'` includes the tests job name.
Re-running probe-sdlc on db-models/onfinance-db-model-master no longer produces fingerprint 68fb754f3fd514b4a98c4fba5a1fd4e45ceb7d4f1af2ccd8371390b545a52a82 (rule ssdf-pw-8-2-test-gate-not-enforced).

verificationMethod.description: Re-run probe-sdlc scoped to db-models/onfinance-db-model-master after the workflow merges and the repo record's ciSystem is refreshed. Expected: the PR.IP.S6 unit-tests gate observation is satisfied (CI present, pytest with coverage floor, required check), and finding fnd_01M2GSSNXD1T94MJ6Q346HV4S6 is not re-produced.

rootCause.description: The shared data-model library was never onboarded to any CI system (ciSystem: none), so changes merge to master with no automated test run and the policy's blocking unit-tests gate exists only on paper for this repo.
